'''Giulio Giorello''' ({{IPA|it|ˈdʒuːljo dʒoˈrɛllo|lang}}; 14 May 1945 – 15 June 2020) was an Italian [[philosopher]], [[mathematician]], and [[epistemologist]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Giulio Giorello |url=http://www.futureofscience.org/speaker/GiulioGiorello%20.html |publisher=The Future of Science Conference |accessdate=11 August 2010 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723205856/http://www.futureofscience.org/speaker/GiulioGiorello%20.html |archivedate=23 July 2011 }}</ref>

==Biography==
{{More citations needed section|date=June 2020}}
Giorello graduated with a degree in [[philosophy]] in 1968 and in [[mathematics]] in 1971 at the [[University of Milan]]. While there, he studied under the philosopher [[Ludovico Geymonat]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Lutto nel mondo della cultura È morto il filosofo Giulio Giorello|url=https://www.ecodibergamo.it/stories/cultura-e-spettacoli/lutto-nel-mondo-della-cultruae-morto-il-filosofo-giulio-giorello_1359632_11/|access-date=2021-07-21|website=www.ecodibergamo.it|date=15 June 2020 |language=it}}</ref> He then taught physics and natural sciences at the [[University of Pavia]], [[University of Catania]], [[University of Insubria]]<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=2020-06-15|title=L'Insubria piange Giulio Giorello|url=https://www.prealpina.it/pages/varese-linsubria-piange-giulio-giorello-225202.html|access-date=2021-07-21|website=La Prealpina - Quotidiano storico di Varese, Altomilanese e Vco.|language=it-IT}}</ref> and the [[University of Milan]].<ref name=":0" /> Giorello was a professor of philosophy of science at the University of Milan;<ref>{{Cite web|date=2014-10-27|title=Pope Francis: 'Evolution ... is not inconsistent with the notion of creation'|url=https://www.ncronline.org/news/vatican/pope-francis-evolution-not-inconsistent-notion-creation|access-date=2021-07-21|website=National Catholic Reporter|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|date=2014-10-28|title=Pope Francis: Big Bang and evolution confirm God exists|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/newsbeat-29799534|access-date=2021-07-21}}</ref> he was also President of SILFS (Italian Society of Logic and Philosophy of Science).<ref name=":1" /> He directed the "Scienza e idee" series by Raffaello Cortina Editore<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://www.raffaellocortina.it/news--promozione-scienza-e-idee-386.html|title=Promozione Scienza e Idee|language=it}}</ref>{{Better source needed|date=July 2021}} and collaborated on the cultural pages of the newspaper [[Corriere della Sera]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-06-15|title=È morto a 75 anni Giulio Giorello, filosofo della scienza|url=http://www.ilpost.it/2020/06/15/giulio-giorello-morto/|access-date=2021-07-21|website=Il Post|language=it-IT}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Giulio Giorello. La popsophia - Filosofia|url=https://www.raicultura.it/filosofia/articoli/2019/01/Giulio-Giorello-la-popsophia-433d0797-3ea8-4b0a-8927-3cd8dc1b24c3.html|access-date=2021-07-21|website=Rai Cultura|language=it}}</ref>

In 2010, Giorello expressed his [[atheistic]] thought with work ''Senza Dio. Del buon uso dell'ateismo'',<ref>{{Cite book|last=Giorello|first=Giulio|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Mq4oywAACAAJ|title=Senza Dio. Del buon uso dell'ateismo|date=2012|publisher=TEA|isbn=978-88-502-2730-3|language=it}}</ref> but in the last years of his life he expressed an [[agnostic]] thought.{{Citation needed|date=July 2021}}

In March 2012 he was a speaker at the national congress of the [[Grand Orient of Italy]] in [[Rimini]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www-ilfattoquotidiano-it.translate.goog/2012/03/26/rimini-tremila-massoni-divisi-congresso-trasparenti-parole-liste-restano-coperte/200095/?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=it&_x_tr_pto=wapp|title=Rimini, 3,000 Freemasons divided at the congress. Transparent in words, but armored lists|language=it|publisher=[[Il Fatto Quotidiano]]|date=March 26, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www-grandeoriente-it.translate.goog/rimini-30-marzo-1-aprile-2012-oltre-la-crisi-la-bussola-dei-valori-per-ritrovare-luomo-gran-loggia-grande-oriente-ditalia/?_x_tr_sl=it&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=it&_x_tr_pto=wapp|publisher=[[Grand Orient of Italy]]|language=it|title=Rimini 30 March 1 April 2012–"Beyond the crisis, the compass of values to rediscover Man" Grand Lodge of the Grand Orient of Italy|date=March 24, 2012}}</ref> Giorello won the 4th edition of the 2012 Frascati Philosophy National Award.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Giulio Giorello si aggiudica il premio Frascati Filosofia – La Città Metropolitana|url=https://www.lacittametropolitana.it/giulio-giorello-si-aggiudica-il-premio-frascati-filosofia/|access-date=2021-07-21|language=it-IT}}</ref>

Giorello died in [[Milan]] on 15 June 2020 due to [[COVID-19]] during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=admin|title=The philosopher Giulio Giorello has died {{!}} News1 English|url=https://www.news1.news/en/2020/06/the-philosopher-giulio-giorello-has-died-2.html|access-date=2020-06-16|language=en-US|archive-date=2020-06-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200616234411/https://www.news1.news/en/2020/06/the-philosopher-giulio-giorello-has-died-2.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> Three days before his death, he married his partner Roberta Pelachin.<ref>{{cite news |title=Morto Giulio Giorello, filosofo della scienza e della libertà |url=https://www.corriere.it/cultura/20_giugno_15/morto-giulio-giorello-filosofo-scienza-difensore-liberta-91f3b350-af26-11ea-a957-8b82646448cc.shtml |accessdate=15 June 2020 |agency=corriere.it |publisher=corriere.it |date=15 June 2020}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Giorello was a "comic book expert"; he wrote essays about [[Tex Willer]] and [[Topolino]], and he also wrote the prefaces to [[Logicomix]] and ''Rat-Man: Superstorie di un supernessuno''.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|last=Rumor|first=Mario A.|date=2020-06-18|title=I fumetti nella filosofia di Giulio Giorello |work=[[Artribune]]|url=https://www.artribune.com/editoria/fumetti/2020/06/giulio-giorello-e-i-fumetti-ricordi/|access-date=2021-07-21|language=it-IT}}</ref> In 2014, he co-created the comic "The philosophy of Donald Duck".<ref name=":2" />

==Works==
* Saggi di storia della matematica, [[Milan]], FER, 1974.
* Il pensiero matematico e l'infinito, [[Milan]], UNICOPLI, 1982. {{ISBN|88-7061-160-4}}.
* Lo spettro e il libertino. Teologia, matematica, libero pensiero, [[Milan]], [[Arnoldo Mondadori Editore|A. Mondadori]], 1985.
* Le ragioni della scienza, with [[Ludovico Geymonat]] and Fabio Minazzi, [[Rome]]-[[Bari]], Laterza, 1986. {{ISBN|88-420-2767-7}}.
* Filosofia della scienza, [[Milan]], Jaca Book, 1992. {{ISBN|88-16-43034-6}}.
* Le stanze della ricerca, [[Milan]], Mazzotta, 1992. {{ISBN|88-202-1057-6}}.
* Europa universitas. Tre saggi sull'impresa scientifica europea, with [[Tullio Regge]] and Salvatore Veca, [[Milan]], [[Feltrinelli (publisher)|Feltrinelli]], 1993. {{ISBN|88-07-09038-4}}.
* Introduzione alla filosofia della scienza, [[Milan]], R.C.S. libri & grandi opere, 1994. {{ISBN|88-452-2128-8}}.
* Quale Dio per la sinistra? Note su democrazia e violenza, with Pietro Adamo, Milan, UNICOPLI, 1994. {{ISBN|88-400-0342-8}}.
* La filosofia della scienza nel XX secolo, with [[Donald A. Gillies|Donald Gillies]], [[Rome]]-[[Bari]], Laterza, 1995. {{ISBN|88-420-4492-X}}
* Lo specchio del reame. Riflessioni su potere e comunicazione, with [[Roberto Esposito]], [[Carlo Sini]] and Danilo Zolo, [[Ravenna]], Longo, 1997. {{ISBN|88-8063-113-6}}.
* Epistemologia applicata. Percorsi filosofici, with Michele Di Francesco, [[Milan]], CUEM, 1999. {{ISBN|88-6001-645-2}}.
* I volti del tempo, with Elio Sindoni, Corrado Sinigaglia, [[Milan]], Bompiani, 2001. {{ISBN|88-452-4973-5}}.
* Prometeo, Ulisse, Gilgameš. Figure del mito, [[Milan]], Raffaello Cortina Editore, 2004. {{ISBN|88-7078-878-4}}.
* Di nessuna chiesa. La libertà del laico, [[Milan]], Raffaello Cortina Editore, 2005. {{ISBN|88-7078-975-6}}.
* Dove fede e ragione si incontrano?, with [[Bruno Forte]], [[Cinisello Balsamo]], San Paolo, 2006. {{ISBN|88-215-5720-0}}.
* La libertà della vita, with [[Umberto Veronesi]], [[Milan]], Raffaello Cortina Editore, 2006. {{ISBN|88-6030-071-1}}.
* Il decalogo. I dieci comandamenti commentati dai filosofi, II, Non nominare il nome di Dio invano, with [[Gabriele Mandel]], with [[CD-ROM|CD]], [[Milan]], Albo Versorio, 2007. {{ISBN| 978-88-89130-26-1}}.
* La scienza tra le nuvole. Da Pippo Newton a Mr Fantastic, with Pier Luigi Gaspa, [[Milan]], Raffaello Cortina Editore, 2007. {{ISBN|978-88-6030-125-3}}.
* Libertà. Un manifesto per credenti e non credenti, with [[Dario Antiseri]], [[Milan]], [[Bompiani]], 2008. {{ISBN|978-88-452-6176-3}}.
